messages:
anne (PM): quick sync — we need to lock alpha acceptance for the observability surface. customers asking for: cost breakdown, traces on error paths, and a simple ops dashboard. who can map gaps by EOD?

jordan (CS): flagged by 3 customers this week — they want per-route cost view and an error-funnel (slowest endpoints -> spike rate). they’ll pay for dedicated views.

raj (Eng): doable but constraints: full-trace capture at 100% increases token-store + egress costs a lot. need rollout plan + sampling + storage tiering.

yuki (SRE): agree. recommend: 10% full traces by default, 100% on sampled errors. need tracing hook in runtime to flip sampling on error code path.

maria (Design): on dashboards — propose 2 personas: "platform operator" (latency, p50/p95, traces link) and "product owner" (per-route cost, error rate, recent runs). simple widgets, low-cardinality filters.

anne (PM): proposed alpha acceptance gates (draft):
- basic cost breakdown per-route (top 20 routes)
- error analytics: aggregate + ability to open traces for top 5 error types
- tracing hooks: on-error sampling toggle + contextual metadata (model, seq_len, deployment)
- dashboard templates for operator & product owner
- rollout plan: beta customers opt-in, default 10% sampling
Please call out any missing non-negotiables.

raj (Eng): calling out missing infra asks:
- retro-compatible telemetry schema (fields: model, version, route, tokens, cost_usd)
- lightweight trace payload (no full input blobs by default)
Example hook snippet we can add to runtime:```python
# attach context and flip sampling on error
def on_response(resp, ctx):
    if resp.status >= 400:
        ctx.trace.sample_rate = 1.0
    else:
        ctx.trace.sample_rate = 0.1
```
We also need storage TTL tiers: 7d hot, 30d warm, 365d archive.

yuki (SRE): +1 for TTL. Also: cost model calc needs to be transparent — add token-based costing line item in UI and export CSV. For spikes, autoscrub traces older than 7d from hot store.

jordan (CS): prioritization from customers: 1) per-route cost 2) error->trace link 3)dashboard templates. they'll accept sampling if error traces are reliable.

anne (PM): decision proposal: ship a narrow alpha with: per-route cost, error analytics (aggregate + 5 trace samples), dashboard templates, tracing hook + sampling defaults. defer full-traffic tracing and long-retention to dedicated capacity/paid tier. asks: engineering estimate for alpha (sprint count) and a minimal acceptance checklist by EOD tomorrow. tagging @raj @yuki @maria — can you confirm feasibility + estimates?

ops-bot: reminder — roadmap sync in #product at 16:00 PT.

raj (Eng): I can do a rough estimate: alpha ~3 sprints (runtime hook + schema + dashboard + CSV export). can compress to 2 if we reduce trace samples to 3 per error type. will follow up with a breakdown.

maria (Design): I’ll draft 2 dashboard templates and a microcopy doc for cost lines by EOD tomorrow.

anne (PM): thanks — if we keep alpha narrow we should have a clear message to customers (opt-in, sampling rules, paid tier for full history). will draft email + beta acceptance criteria after estimates land.
